title: PhysxVehicleMultiWheelDifferentialAPI
summary: Which wheels of a vehicle are driven and how the drive torque splits among them, applied on the vehicle prim. Outside the differential parse the runtime only checks that the vehicle prim lists it (or PhysxVehicleTankDifferentialAPI), to attach the parsed differential to the vehicle.

interactions.rule: When a differential API is listed on the vehicle prim but no differential was parsed for it, the vehicle is not created. A vehicle with a differential needs a drive, and the wheel indices must be below the wheel count.
A prim that also lists PhysxVehicleTankDifferentialAPI is parsed as a tank differential, which carries these columns too.

notes: The parser reads and validates physxVehicleMultiWheelDifferential:wheels, torqueRatios and averageWheelSpeedRatios, and the runtime applies their live changes. They are not described yet.
